title: Credit Balance Refund Amount on Northgate Card Accounts — Account Services Computation Note
content:
**When the refund is fixed.** The credit balance refund is fixed only after every late fee that is the only late fee of the last 12 months, with at least 1.00 of it still standing after the reversals already posted against it, on an account with no courtesy reversal in that time carries its courtesy reversal.

**Credit balance.** On a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account the credit balance is the amount owed on the account below zero, and nothing when the account owes money.

**Refund.** The credit balance refund is the whole credit balance. The refund is the credit balance less every amount this rule holds, never less than zero, kept to the cent.

**Windows.** A count or total over the last 12 months takes the entries dated after the same calendar day 12 months before today, and one over the last month the entries dated after the same calendar day one month before today.

## Worked figures (hypothetical accounts)

| Amount owed on the account | Credit balance | Credit balance refund |
|---|---|---|
| minus 245.30 (a credit balance) | 245.30 | 245.30 |
| minus 0.40 | 0.40 | 0.40 |
| 0.00 | nothing | nothing |
| 18.00 (money owed) | nothing | nothing |
